name: infomaniak-ai
description: Inspect Infomaniak infrastructure; optionally use scoped API operations and independently approved writes.

api_token.title: Infomaniak API token
api_token.description: Your own Infomaniak API token for the product scopes you need. Token-only discovery performs reads; a scoped policy is required for controlled writes.

backend_path.title: Reviewed MCP server build
backend_path.description: Optional reviewed MCP backend for the original edition. Token-only discovery needs no backend.

backend_sha256.title: MCP build SHA-256
backend_sha256.description: Required with backend_path; checksum of the reviewed entry file.

policy_file.title: Optional API access policy
policy_file.description: Private access.local.json for the controlled API runtime. Without it, start token-only discovery or the optional original read-only MCP adapter.
